title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map calendar archives for 2022–2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with captured text/images and explicit source gaps.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 caption exports. Daily Maps: 2026 has 201 maps/198 dates plus two undated commentaries; 2025 has 246/242; 2024 has 251/247; 2023 has 248/245; 2022 has 158/157, May 16–December 30, plus one stale article kept separately. All 1,764 scoped calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Annual snapshots retain gaps and duplicate dates. 2022 has a substantial early-year gap and pinned source-year exceptions; stale 2021 content stays separate. Earlier source/image qualifications remain explicit. No trading validation.
